entities.text: Saran Cyber P.S. Case No. 57 of 2024
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: As per the prosecution case, on 06.03.2024 the complainant went to Dighwara Branch of the State Bank of India and complained that from his phone-pay account the money was not being transferred.

The Bank officially informed him that there was no issue from the bank's end and suggested him to talk to the Customer Care of phone-pay as his limit has Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.53629 of 2024(3) dt.08-10-2024 been closed.

Further, the Bank told him that total Rs.
8,11,927/- has been withdrawn from his account by the holder of mobile no. 08068727374 and 7810927899.
4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case.
The petitioner is not named in the F.I.R.
The name of the petitioner has transpired during the course of investigation.
The petitioner has no concern with the alleged occurrence.
Nothing has been recovered from the conscious possession of the petitioner.
